notes.title: 07/02/2024 - UPDATE 4 - Performance!
notes.notes:
07/02/2024 - UPDATE 4 - Performance!

Control Fixes
You will now press E to add power and complete the pre shot mini games to make life easier!
You will only have to use Z and X to switch clubs, instances of tab being used have been removed

Performance Changes
You can now change the graphic settings for some in game graphics
Tree render distances have been updated, new LODs have been added increasing performance by 30% on tested machines!

Gameplay changes
You can now switch between practice and normal shot more easily!
The font in game has been changed to make the user experience better!
Rain audio looping issue resolved
"Skip shot" has been removed when the hole is over and skipping is unecessary
Money spawning issues resolved, when close to money it will now be dragged towards the player!

notes.title: 27/01/2024 - UPDATE 3!
notes.notes:
27/01/2024 - UPDATE 3!

In update 3 you should notice some performance improvements!

The driving range achievements have been changed, originally scoring a high score would block all achievements under this score. You will now unlock all of these achievements!

You can now reset all progress! You can find this option in the settings menu. There is a check incase you miss click but do not miss click twice!

You will notice that in various holes you can now find fish and in Forest Island some other land animals such as frogs!

There has been some further love to the bunker mechanics, the ball should act more naturally now.

notes.title: 09/01/2023 - Update 2.5
notes.notes: The driving range has had some love and the updates are live here now too!

notes.title: 05/01/2024 - Update 2
notes.notes:
Bunker Bouncing - The ball will now act more naturally when interacting with bunkers and the rough.

Cart Customisation - Update your cart with 9 new colours you can purchase when levelling up!

Double UI Glitch -  When applying more power, the accuracy mini game UI will not reset.

Respawn points have been updated and reset to keep your player and the ball out of the water!

Most importantly... you can now be bald!
